description.value: A fully automated, cross-center multimodal computational framework combining structural MRI morphometric features and resting-state functional connectivity to classify patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia and healthy controls.

spans.text: We developed an automatic, cross-center, multimodal computational approach for robust classification of patients with bvFTD and healthy controls.

value: We expect that our multimodal approach will outperform classification results considering only one neuroimaging modality (atrophy or FC).
